scope: Targeted recipe/material reading of all 30 newly lost literal-code-only families, the four AV-absent available families, and all eight first-slot warnings. Not a second full reading of 88 trajectories and not new generation/execution.
warning_screen: The author-listed first slot in a recipe is only a navigation cue, not a deterministic host-selection algorithm. Presence of a preferred material elsewhere may mean it provides only input or an oracle.

first_slot_warnings.S020/G1: The missing operation is OpenApi generation. Existing annotated OpenApi probe or stock OpenApi test provides the direct harness; the Agent SSE runtime test supplies endpoint/schema inputs. An AV-based test can be extended with a new OpenApi consumer, but this is cross-API composition, not preserved-operation context-only repair.
first_slot_warnings.S056/G2: CollapseGroups operation/harness comes from stock collapse tests or implementation. Agent ConvertShape tests supply structural-selector inputs. Fixing the Agent operation itself would keep the wrong consumer; prefer the repository host or explicitly replace the consumer.
first_slot_warnings.S056/G3: Protected/free branches must be consumed by CollapseGroups. Agent shape tests provide selectors and expected structure, whereas repo collapse tests give the target execution. AV co-occurrence is not a proof of a suitable preserved-operation host.
first_slot_warnings.S056/G4: Empty group preservation must run RemoveEmptyContainers. Stock empty-container tests or that API source are the direct host/consumer; Agent structural-selector tests are inputs, not the target consumer.
first_slot_warnings.S056/G5: Same empty-consumer distinction for a child selector. The source category supplying the useful host is repository test, while Agent material is the selector donor.
first_slot_warnings.S082/G2: Mocha Agent tests contribute abort state and completion observation; missing Jasmine specDone registration/callback shape is available in source. A new Jasmine adapter harness is needed. Ordinary slicing from a Mocha execution does not by itself reach this independent adapter.
first_slot_warnings.S082/G4: Mocha tests likewise do not execute QUnit.testDone or its queue. The QUnit source is an independent target-API ingredient; a new adapter harness is required. A code-only AV/probe/repo-test filter does not preserve this currently recorded API material.

recommended_host_definition: An editable executable check that supplies target operation or its producer/consumer interface, concrete setup, and an observation location. Choose its category after its behavioral role; attach source/fixture/output/contract material without making every attachment a free global pairing dimension.
supported_claim: All 148 families with recorded complete material sets retain at least one set containing an Agent test or temporary probe. Three raw provenance classes alone do not prove all these materials are executable directed hosts or sufficient generation inputs.
generation_validation: Not performed in this run. Check retained operation/API, setup bindings, reached path and independent oracle when generating tests; existence of a source set is an availability result.
